context: Four fixed five-second contexts, not an independent recording or a full endpoint. See subsequent priority-status correction in prestart history.

model_provenance.spatial_encoding: Pinned FIF-default parity: float32 arithmetic, integer truncation, 100 bins from -0.12 to +0.12 m. Not proof of training coordinates; no geometric rescale.
model_provenance.normalization: Per-window single mean and population standard deviation from retained channels only; scale to std 0.1; target tokens exactly zero. Apply inverse scalar transformation from retained channels only. No additional re-reference or filter.
model_provenance.upstream_pipeline_difference: Uses the pinned low-level model sample API; deliberately does not use upstream per-channel normalization, automatic average reference, filtering, masking heuristics, or seam corrections. This is a PRAYCG experimental operationalization, not an exact reproduction of the published evaluation.
model_provenance.context_seam_limitation: Independent model contexts and reflected final padding can affect spectra and errors; no hidden-target seam anchoring is permitted.
model_provenance.license_review_limitation: The wheel includes Meta copyright headers and an Llama 2 notice in eeg_eval.py alongside project Apache-2.0 metadata.
